references.text: It is mentioned here that the descendants of Gershon received thirteen cities by lot, which corresponds to the total number of cities summarized in verse 33.
The Gershonites from the Levitical clan received cities from the half-tribe of Manasseh, and this verse begins the listing of the cities that are summed up in verse 33.
Here the Gershonite clans and their duties in the tabernacle are described, providing background for why they were given cities in Israel.
God's command that the Levites should receive cities with pastureland around them is fulfilled here with the thirteen cities given to the Gershonites.
A parallel text that also summarizes the cities given to the Gershonites from the tribes of Israel.
